module: Second CVT gearbox logic, driven by a map (target speed = f(wheel speed, aggression)) instead of a simple interpolator. Modes P R N D S. S mode enables simulated fixed gears (sport "steps") with a delay between changes. Loaded by vehicleController via jbeam shiftLogicName = "cvtGearbox2" (the "gearbox" device must be of type cvtGearbox for automatic selection, otherwise name the module explicitly). Sets the continuous ratio through gearbox:setGearRatio and a converter lockup with hysteresis.
notes: jbeam keys read in init: cvtGearRatioSmoothingIn (6), cvtGearRatioSmoothingOut (4), cvtLockupSmoothing (5), automaticModes ("PRND"), defaultAutomaticMode ("N"), lockupMinWheelspeed (2 m/s), lockupMinRpmDiff (50), lockupMaxRpmDiff (400), cvtTargetRPMMap (data for interpolatedMap: wheel speed / aggression axes -> RPM), cvtSportGearShiftCooldown (1 s), cvtSportGearRatios (array of decreasing ratios).

The target speed comes from cvtTargetRPMMap:get(wheelspeed, drivingAggression); target ratio = target speed / gearbox output speed, bounded by minGearRatio/maxGearRatio, then smoothed. In R, ratio = maxGearRatio.

Bug spotted: init always sets cvtHandling.useFixedGearRatios = false when reading cvtSportGearRatios (valid or not); the option is only re-enabled by applyGearboxMode in S mode, called at the end of init. If cvtTargetRPMMap is missing, loadData receives nil.
The lockup (lockupClutchRatio) is only active if a "torqueConverter" device exists and lockupMinWheelspeed > 0; it depends on the gap between target speed and engine speed, on speed and on throttle.
No "whileShifting" logic: updateGearboxGFX stays inGear. In arcade shiftUp/Down display a warning; shiftToGearIndex switches to realistic.
Virtual gear: P=-2, R=-1, N=0, D=1, S=2. currentGearIndex = 0 in P/N.

Common shiftLogic contract: gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior, smoothedValues injected by vehicleController. M.running written without declaration.

throttle.desc: Throttle (0..1), swapped with the brake in arcade reverse.

minGearIndex.desc: Absolute value of the smallest index (init).

isManualModeActive.desc: True in M modes (not available in practice).

updateGearboxGFX.desc: nop then inGear of the active mode.

init.desc: Creates smoothers, mode list, lockup parameters, target speed map and S mode fixed ratios; applies the default mode. Called by vehicleController (init and reset).

gearboxBehaviorChanged.desc: Selects the arcade or realistic logic.

areShiftLEDsInUse.desc: True outside arcade in manual mode (never in practice).

getGearName.desc: Mode name: P, R, N, D, or "S<n>" in sport (n = current fixed step).

getGearPosition.desc: Normalized lever position and mode index.

shiftToGearIndex.desc: Realistic: mode matching the lever position; nonexistent -> message and N.

index.desc: Lever position (-1 R, 0 N, 1 P, 2 D, 3 S).

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks the engine to send its torque curves to the UI.
